segments.text: Ok so this is the use interrupt page for Vue with Google Antigravity, and I'm reporting a problem on this page.
So this is the problem, the page says Antigravity can't pause mid tool, so use human in the loop instead.
But the frontend and backend sections for that, umm, have no code.
And the app imports meeting chat, which is never shown.
This is my project, I've implemented the exact code from the doc.
This part wasn't on the page, the agent with the meeting tool, so I had to add it myself.
Moving on to the demo. Scheduling a meeting should show an approve card, and it only shows because of code from other pages.
So basically, the page points you to human in the loop but gives no code for it, so you have to guess the whole thing.
So umm, this one needs fixing, please look into it.
